features.summary: Collect and audit daily AI sources before writing the structured report.
acceptance: Candidate sources record successful, failed, and empty checks.
Selected items point back to candidate IDs.
Freshness, duplicate URL, and source-window decisions are recorded before report writing.
stop_conditions: Required source audit fields cannot be reconstructed.
The draft would bypass candidate-pool or freshness gates.

features.summary: Normalize the structured draft into report data and candidate audit files.
acceptance: `report:write` succeeds without candidate-pool, freshness, or duplicate wrapping errors.
The structured JSON keeps required empty arrays instead of omitting optional sections.
`self_check.optimization_suggestions` captures prompt or rule follow-up proposals with canonical fields.

features.summary: Turn user-confirmed recurring feedback into durable validation-backed project behavior.
acceptance: Open P1 feedback ledger items include existing scope paths, a validation command covered by `npm run validate`, and a test name that exists in `tests/**`.
`npm run validate` runs the feedback contract gate.
Prompt module metadata remains aligned with `prompts/ai-daily/manifest.json`.
stop_conditions: A user-confirmed persistent feedback item has no real scope file, executable validate-chain command, or existing test assertion.
Prompt module metadata drifts from the manifest.

features.summary: Render the daily report to static GitHub Pages output through effective-interact.
acceptance: `npm run build` writes the daily HTML, JSON data, feed, and index.
Daily HTML is generated by `.codex/skills/effective-interact` in `pre-rendered` mode.
`npm run validate` passes before any real publish attempt.
stop_conditions: The report renderer falls back to a hand-written daily template.

features.summary: Prepare or inspect the publish worktree before publishing artifacts.
commands: npm run publish:prepare-worktree -- --message "chore: save local changes before AI daily report YYYY-MM-DD"
acceptance: Branch, remote, worktree, and git-write state are inspected before real publish.
Unrelated dirty changes are isolated or explicitly reported.
A preflight failure is treated as a publish boundary, not as permission to skip validation.
stop_conditions: Local changes cannot be preserved safely.
The task would require `git reset --hard`, force push, or overwriting user work.

features.summary: Preview publish artifacts, commit message, and expected Pages URL.
acceptance: `publish:dry-run` reports managed publish files only.
Expected Pages URL is captured before real publish.
Dry-run failures preserve generated local HTML and JSON artifacts.
stop_conditions: Dry-run cannot determine the publish plan.

features.summary: Publish generated artifacts to `main` only after explicit confirmation.
acceptance: Only `docs/` and `reports-data/` publisher-managed artifacts are committed.
GitHub API fallback is used only for local `.git` metadata or branch-switching failures.
Final handoff includes HTTP verification for the daily Pages URL.
stop_conditions: The user has not explicitly authorized real publish.
The publish would write non-publisher-managed files.
No suitable GitHub token is available for API fallback.

features.summary: Keep Codex task state, runbook, and validation gates aligned with the daily publishing workflow.
acceptance: `tasks/current-task.md` defines scope before implementation or publish work starts.
`tasks/daily-publish-runbook.md` remains the operating sequence for daily publish runs.
`session-handoff.md` records validation, publish status, residual risk, and next action.
stop_conditions: Harness files no longer match the daily publishing scripts.
Validation evidence is missing from the handoff.

worktree_policy.write_task_isolation: Use one git worktree or branch per write task.
worktree_policy.code_organization: Keep source code organized by project architecture, not by agent task folders.
